files.content:
# Talos control plane node machine configuration.
# Talos v1.9.5
version: v1alpha1
machine:
  type: controlplane
  kubelet:
    image: registry.k8s.io/kubelet:v1.36.1
    defaultRuntimeSeccompProfileEnabled: true
  network:
    interfaces:
      - interface: eth0
        dhcp: false
        addresses:
          - 10.0.0.10/24
        routes:
          - network: 0.0.0.0/0
            gateway: 10.0.0.1
cluster:
  id: eval-fixtures-talos
  clusterName: eval-fixtures-talos
  secretbox: $TALOS_SECRETBOX
  controlPlane:
    endpoints:
      - https://control-plane.eval-fixtures.internal:6443
  network:
    dnsDomain: cluster.local
    podSubnets:
      - 10.42.0.0/16
    serviceSubnets:
      - 10.43.0.0/16

# Talos worker node machine configuration.
# Talos v1.9.5 — supported Kubernetes versions live in docs/platform/talos-support-matrix.md
version: v1alpha1
machine:
  type: worker
  kubelet:
    image: registry.k8s.io/kubelet:v1.36.2
    defaultRuntimeSeccompProfileEnabled: true
  extraKernelArgs:
    - apparmor=0
cluster:
  id: eval-fixtures-talos
  clusterName: eval-fixtures-talos
  secretbox: $TALOS_SECRETBOX
  controlPlane:
    endpoints:
      - https://control-plane.eval-fixtures.internal:6443
  apiServer:
    image: ghcr.io/siderolabs/kube-apiserver:v1.36.2
  network:
    dnsDomain: cluster.local
    podSubnets:
      - 10.42.0.0/16
    serviceSubnets:
      - 10.43.0.0/16

# Platform docs

Reference documentation for the platform layer of this repository.

- [Talos ↔ Kubernetes support matrix](talos-support-matrix.md) — the pinned
  Talos/Kubernetes compatibility table. Check it before changing a Kubernetes
  version under `cluster/talos/machineconfig/`.

# Talos ↔ Kubernetes support matrix

Pinned compatibility table for the Talos releases deployed in this cluster.
The Kubernetes minor version deployed on a host must fall inside the range
listed for the Talos version actually running on that host — the deployed
platform version is recorded in `cluster/talos/machineconfig/worker.yaml`.

| Talos version | Supported Kubernetes versions |
| --- | --- |
| Talos v1.9.3 | Kubernetes v1.30 – v1.32 |
| Talos v1.9.4 | Kubernetes v1.30 – v1.33 |
| Talos v1.9.5 | Kubernetes v1.31 – v1.33 |
| Talos v1.10.0 | Kubernetes v1.32 – v1.34 |

A Kubernetes version outside the supported range is an unsupported
combination: upgrade the Talos platform version first, then the Kubernetes
minor version.
